emma: Quick plan  want a 4-post social run for Sunrise webinar next week. Channels: X + LinkedIn. Posts = teaser, case-study highlight, partner quote, last-call. Need final assets + UTMs by Wed noon.

ben: Got it. Who's owning hero and video? specs?

emma: I'll handle hero. Dims: LI 1200x627, X 1200x675, thumb 800x800. Video cuts: 15s (organic), 30s (teaser), 30s silent for paid. Upload to /Marketing/Campaigns/sunrise/assets.

priya: I'll write copy (engineer/product tones) and post drafts by Mon morning. Any blacklist words?

noah: Legal: avoid specific benchmark claims and absolutes without approval. Use "measurable improvements" or "reduces latency variability" instead.

emma: Copy theme = "Predictable inference across hosted, dedicated, and private". CTA = "Reserve your spot".

samir: For lead routing append UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=sunrise_launch&utm_content=(teaser|case|partner|last). Push leads to queue `sunrise-webinar`.

ops-bot: Short links provisioned:
- teaser: https://rwd.link/sr1
- case-study: https://rwd.link/sr2
- partner: https://rwd.link/sr3
- last-call: https://rwd.link/sr4
All include base UTMs; replace utm_content before scheduling.

ben: Scheduling plan: X posts 9am PT, LI posts 11am PT. Partner quote best at 2pm PT. Thoughts?

priya: Drafts (product tone):
Teaser (LI): "Ship reliable inference. Join Sunrise to learn pragmatic patterns for latency SLOs and cost control across deployments. Reserve your spot: <short link>"
Case-study (X): "How Acme cut unit cost with routing + caching. See the config patterns in our webinar: <short link>"

emma: Swap any hard numbers for qualitative phrasing until partner/legal signs off. Also request partners to confirm handles before tagging.

samir: Paid boost ask: $450 for the case-study post targeted to dev/platform titles in NA/EMEA. Approve?

emma: Approve $450. Please submit boost form with creative id `sunrise_case_paid`.

ben: Design deadline Tue 3pm. If blocked, fallback to single hero + 15s.

priya: Noted. I'll post final copy variants and a short checklist by Mon 10am.

emma: Final handoff checklist for Wed noon: assets in drive, approved copy per platform, short links with utm_content set, partner tag approvals, paid boost submitted, scheduler drafts queued. Marking this thread canonical for Sunrise social ops. :sunrise_over_mountains:
